headline: Mercy and Berm Still Burn as Mooring Falls Quiet
war_summary: The late wires recast the overnight picture, with Palantine Berm rekindling to four changes in two hours and twenty-six in the day about Vendett and Windburn Landing, now two Warden and five Colonial after the 04:55 wire, while Linn Mercy remains close with three changes in two hours and fourteen in the day about Outwich Ranch and Lathair, now ten Colonial and one neutral after the 05:20 wire amid day losses near 8,800 Colonial and 15,800 Warden. Mooring County has gone quiet in the last two hours after three changes in six hours and twenty-seven in the day about MacConmara Barrows and the Wind Hills, still twelve Warden after the 02:21 wire, as has the Gutter with none in two hours after three in six about Suojus. Marban Hollow, Weathered Expanse, Nevish Line, Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand show no movement in six hours despite twenty, thirty-four, six, nine and eight changes in the day respectively, though Nevish, Stlican and Clahstra report heavy and quickening losses without fresh flips, and Callahan's Passage likewise records sharp losses without a recorded change.
